onboarding.title: Project Hub
onboarding.body: Organize work by project. Group projects into folders in the sidebar, then track everything for each one in its own tabs.

onboarding.title: Getting around
onboarding.body: Pick a project in the sidebar, then switch tabs to fill in its details.
tips: Use the sidebar to add folders and projects.
Each project has Brief, Roles, Milestones, Issues, Action Items, Decisions, and Links.
Right-click this app's desktop icon to rename or remove it.
Replay this intro anytime from the ⚙️ settings button.
